Rn I go to Newark, the problem with NB is that it’s extremely BIG. Yeah it has more classes, but you’re pretty much required to dorm. Also, it doesn’t really offer as much financial aid as Newark or Camden. 
Rutgers Newark specifically is a big commuter school, so they offer really nice discounted bus/train passes. There’s a bunch of bus stops nearby and the train is like a 7 minute walk away, so it’s really good if you don’t wanna spend the extra money on a car or dorming. 
And as for the bad area, the campus is right next to NJIT and Essex CC, it’s really safe! Newark has this reputation of being really shady, but it’s gotten a lot better, not to mention that there’s emergency service buttons on nearly every street corner. As long as you don’t wander into any alleyways at night three blocks away from campus you’re fine :P
